Reviewed source consumers name precomputed Stata handoffs for which the reviewed supplied source bodies do not establish a producer or full input contract: Add_CEO_hometown_finish.dta, CDM_Holdfirm_after_sim.dta, extended_sample.dta, extend_sample_CDM_ind.dta, company_link.dta, CEO_change_sample_clean.dta, final_sample_2014.dta, and the AR_firm_date_all_MktModelAdj_<var>.dta family.

Registered dependency metadata includes a company-address workbook edge at line 11, but that source section is masked in the approved viewer; native fields, producer, and role remain unresolved, so this is an edge clarification rather than a confirmed standalone data requirement.
